title: Telemetry sender app
brief: Screens for the app that captures vehicle telemetry (device_id, seq, captured_at, lat/lon, speed_kmh, heading_deg, accuracy_m, mode moving|heartbeat) and sends batches to POST /v1/telemetry in fleet-telemetry. Three directions for the same sender app.

artboards.title: Ops console
artboards.tradeoff: Fleet-wide live view: map, device list, intake feed in one dense dark screen; steep learning curve for non-operators

artboards.title: Wire inspector
artboards.tradeoff: Transparent about the contract: JSON payload, dedup, skew and watermark visible; intimidating for non-technical staff

artboards.title: Drive — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Chosen direction: blue gradient hero shell holding the speed ring, today stats card and delivery timeline

artboards.title: Queue — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Fleet One redesign of the batch queue: summary strip, per-batch cards with detail rows and contract note

artboards.title: Sync — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Fleet One redesign of sync: green status hero, clock and endpoint cards, primary/secondary actions

artboards.title: More — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Fleet One redesign of settings: unit card, working System/Light/Dark theme switch, SVG icon rows, scrollable

artboards.title: Move tracker (reassignment) — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Reached from More's Move tracker row: warns the current link releases, keeps the device_id, targets a new unit; cancelable

artboards.title: Mesh mark — chosen brand symbol
artboards.tradeoff: Refined node mesh: hub + triangle of fleet nodes, accent reporting node; shown at 3 sizes plus lockup

artboards.title: Splash — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Brand entry: mark, wordmark, config check loader; shown while the app decides first-run vs. resume

artboards.title: Welcome — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: First-run only: three value cards and the Set up my tracker CTA that leads into Add tracker; includes data policy note

artboards.title: Add tracker (first-time setup) — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Modal wizard for initial pairing: type or scan device code, vehicle type, pick unit; no app nav, unit unknown until chosen
